material_developments.topic: Dell fiscal Q3 FY2027 AI infrastructure results
material_developments.evidence: Dell IR release and SEC-filed exhibit report $54.937 billion revenue, $22.031 billion AI-Optimized Server revenue, $60.2 billion AI-server orders, $132.3 billion AI backlog and increased FY27 guidance.
material_developments.interpretation: Strong supplier-level evidence that AI infrastructure demand is converting into reported revenue. Backlog remains subject to delivery, customer funding, power and component constraints.

material_developments.evidence: Reuters reported Goldman Sachs estimate that an additional 52 GW of US data-center power capacity could come online in 2028 and that year-to-date capacity and demand had risen nearly 30%.
material_developments.interpretation: Power generation, grid access, electrical equipment and cooling remain material infrastructure constraints. The figures are analyst estimates, not realised capacity.

material_developments.evidence: Reuters reported record CDS spreads for Oracle, Alphabet, SpaceX and CoreWeave; SoftBank at 501 bps, Oracle at 356 bps and CoreWeave at 1,314 bps.
material_developments.interpretation: Credit markets are scrutinising debt-funded AI infrastructure, circular financing and cash-flow timing. CDS spreads and modelled default probabilities are risk-pricing indicators, not defaults.

contextual_items.treatment: Secondary-source context only. Reuters report was opened, but the underlying Enverus report was not retrieved. Not used as a definitive water-use benchmark.
